tools.name: unity-assets-library-20261019.json
tools.description: The public library of finished world assets, findastra/unity-assets-library: one folder per asset and version with the .unitypackage, previews and a checksummed manifest, indexed in library.json. Versions arrive only from unity-asset-creator's step 12, as pull requests Astra merges.
tools.command_template: gh repo clone findastra/unity-assets-library, then read library.json (schema unity-unicorn.library/v1). To add a version, publish it from the world project: python -I Tools/unity-asset-creator/publish-asset-20261018.py --library <that clone>
requirements: Reading is public. Adding a version is a pull request opened by unity-asset-creator's publisher, and Astra merges it.
limitations: No licence chosen yet: until Astra picks one, ask before using an asset outside her worlds.
Two versions so far, both from Liminal Doors stop 1: liminal-doors-phone-booth 1.0.0 and liminal-doors-stop-01-sky 1.0.0 (PR #1, merged 2026-10-19).
The publisher refuses a file over 95 MB (GitHub's limit is 100 MB a file), paid store assets and any file that names a machine path.
